info.title: GovernedGraph design-depth agent APIM facade
info.description: ILLUSTRATIVE - synthetic data. Contract design only, not an imported/deployed API. Writes use idempotency keys; calculation scheduling is queue-only. The production APIM adapter must enforce approved tool permissions and bind journey/member scope from authenticated context. The shared escalation operation is available to all three agents. No release, rules-edit, entitlement, eligibility or complex-case-close operation exists.
